name: JobsPipe: Find Open Roles for Company
description: Search for all open job postings from a company by domain name
notes: Replace YOUR_JOBSPIPE_API_KEY with your actual API key from https://jobspipe.dev/dashboard
Replace {{company_domain}} with a Clay column reference like /column1
Costs 1 credit per job returned (not already paid this month)
Returns up to 25 jobs; adjust 'limit' as needed (max varies by plan)
posted_at_max_age_days filters to jobs posted in last N days
